name: IconButton
purpose: Triggers an action via a single icon, with no visible text label — a toolbar action, a row action, a close/dismiss control.
neverUseFor: Any action without an unambiguous, universally recognizable icon — use Button with a text label instead; a mystery-meat icon is worse than no shortcut at all
The primary CTA of a view — a labelled Button reads with more intent and is easier to scan for
A toggle/pressed state (e.g. bold/italic in a toolbar) — that needs aria-pressed and a distinct on/off visual, neither of which IconButton models; compose a dedicated toggle control instead
rationale: IconButton shares Button's exact height scale (ADR-004) by aliasing the same semantic.size rungs, so an icon-only action always lines up with a labelled Button beside it. Because there is no visible text, the accessible label is required by the type system (4.1.2), and it's limited to universally recognizable icons.

mayExtendLocally: Choose the icon, label and variant per usage
Wrap it in a Tooltip that repeats the label
mustEscalateToDS: Making the label optional or new sizes outside s/m/l
Overriding padding, radius or color tokens

anatomy.description: Root — a real <button>, square (width = height, same token), fill/border/radius by variant. Never a <div> with a click handler.

props.name: icon
props.description: The icon to render, passed by reference (e.g. IconTrash), not pre-instantiated.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name — there is no visible text for this to describe, so it's required, not optional. Rendered as the button's aria-label.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style — same 4-variant system as Button. Defaults to 'ghost' (not Button's 'primary'): an icon-only control is almost always a secondary/utility action (toolbar, row action, dismiss), rarely a view's main CTA.

props.name: size
props.description: Physical size — same scale and same height tokens as Button (s=24px, m=32px, l=40px), width matches height (square).

props.name: isLoading
props.description: When true, shows a spinner in place of the icon and disables interaction.

props.name: disabled
props.description: When true, the button is non-interactive.

height.note: Identical to Button's own height scale (ADR-004 Control scale) — component.iconButton.height aliases the same semantic.size.* rungs Button's component.button.height does, so the two components always stay the same physical height at a matching size.

width.note: Always equal to height (square) — aliases the SAME token as height, not an independent value. An icon-only control has no text to size around, so 'hug'/'fill' don't apply.

keyboardNav: Enter/Space activates, same as any native <button>
wcag: 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (label is required precisely to satisfy this — no visible text exists to fall back on)

motion: CSS transitions/animations: neutralised by the global prefers-reduced-motion rule

figma.variantCombinations: 64 variants (2026-10-21): variant × size × state = 48,  disabled per variant × size = 12,  isLoading once per variant at size m = 4. label is the aria-label: no Figma property.
